text: Ines Pereira is a Staff Platform Engineer at HealthCloud Solutions, where she leverages 13 years of expertise in healthtech to drive scalable infrastructure and operational excellence. Her work centers on architecting robust cloud-native solutions, with a focus on Kubernetes deployments that support high-availability systems across multiple regions. She owns critical projects that have reduced platform downtime by 40% through proactive monitoring and automated scaling strategies. Terraform plays a central role in her workflow, enabling reproducible infrastructure across AWS and GCP environments, while her cost-optimization initiatives have lowered annual cloud expenditures by 22% through resource tagging and reserved instance strategies. Ines collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to align engineering practices with business goals, ensuring seamless integration of new services without compromising security or performance. Her technical leadership extends to mentoring junior engineers and refining CI/CD pipelines to accelerate deployment cycles. Outside of work, she remains engaged with industry trends, particularly in healthcare digital transformation, and actively contributes to open-source projects focused on cloud resilience. A strategic thinker with a pragmatic approach, Ines balances innovation with operational discipline to deliver reliable, future-ready platforms.
